question.text:
But-2-yne and hydrogen (one mole each) are separately treated with (i) $\mathrm{Pd} / \mathrm{C}$ and (ii) $\mathrm{Na} / \mathrm{liq}. \mathrm{NH}_{3}$ to give the products X and Y respectively.

Identify the incorrect statements.
A. $X$ and $Y$ are stereoisomers.
B. Dipole moment of X is zero.
C. Boiling point of $X$ is higher than $Y$.
D. X and Y react with $\mathrm{O}_{3} / \mathrm{Zn}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ to give different products.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
